text: Hello.
Welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 欢迎来到《真正简易英语》。
zh_hant: 歡迎來到《真正簡易英語》。

text: We're back with another conversation in Easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们又回来了，带来一段简易英语对话，帮你学习。
zh_hant: 我們又回來了，帶來一段簡易英語對話，幫你學習。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
You can find a video of this podcast with subtitles over on our website.
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到带字幕的这期播客视频。
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到帶字幕的這期播客影片。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth, how are you?
I'm good, thank you.
Neil, how are you?
I'm very well.
Today, we're talking about animals, not pets, though.
zh: 今天，我们要聊动物，不过不是宠物。
zh_hant: 今天，我們要聊動物，不過不是寵物。

text: We're talking about wild animals.
And wild animals are animals that live
zh: 野生动物指的是那些生活在
zh_hant: 野生動物指的是那些生活在

text: without the help of humans.
zh: 没有人类帮助下的动物。
zh_hant: 沒有人類幫助下的動物。

text: Do you have a favourite wild animal then?
zh: 那你有最喜欢的野生动物吗？
zh_hant: 那你有最喜歡的野生動物嗎？

text: Well, I think I like the gazelle.
I was not expecting that answer.
zh: 我没想到你会这么回答。
zh_hant: 我沒想到你會這麼回答。

text: Why a gazelle?
Because they are so elegant.
You know, they kind of float and bounce when they're running.
zh: 你知道吗，它们跑起来的时候像是漂浮和弹跳一样。
zh_hant: 你知道嗎，它們跑起來的時候像是漂浮和彈跳一樣。

text: And I think they just look really beautiful.
zh: 而且我觉得它们看起来真的很美。
zh_hant: 而且我覺得它們看起來真的很美。

text: Okay.
Have you seen a gazelle in the wild?
I haven't, no.
Okay.
We don't have many interesting wild animals in the UK.
zh: 英国没有太多有趣的野生动物。
zh_hant: 英國沒有太多有趣的野生動物。

text: We do.
They're all small.
We have squirrels.
Yes.
And foxes.
And rats.
Well, yeah.
Everywhere has rats.
Hedgehogs.
Hedgehogs are cute.
Yes.
And I have seen deer.
Oh, yeah.
Same.
I have a squirrel story, actually.
zh: 其实，我有一个关于松鼠的故事。
zh_hant: 其實，我有一個關於松鼠的故事。

text: Go on.
I was asleep the other day.
I heard a noise.
It woke me up.
And I went into the bathroom,
and there was a squirrel on the floor in my bathroom,
zh: 有一只松鼠在我浴室的地板上，
zh_hant: 有一隻松鼠在我浴室的地板上，

text: and it saw me, and it jumped out the window,
zh: 它看见了我，就从窗户跳了出去，
zh_hant: 它看見了我，就從窗戶跳了出去，

text: and I thought, have I gone crazy?
Am I...
Dreaming, but there was a squirrel in my bathroom.
zh: 在做梦，但我的浴室里确实有一只松鼠。
zh_hant: 在做夢，但我的浴室裡確實有一隻松鼠。

text: Thankfully, it didn't come into the house.
zh: 幸好，它没有进到屋里来。
zh_hant: 幸好，它沒有進到屋裡來。

text: Have you ever seen a really interesting or unusual animal?
zh: 你见过什么特别有趣或者不寻常的动物吗？
zh_hant: 你見過什麼特別有趣或者不尋常的動物嗎？

text: More?
I have.
I saw blue whales many years ago.
I was traveling with a friend,
zh: 我当时和一个朋友在旅行，
zh_hant: 我當時和一個朋友在旅行，

text: and we went
on a boat to try and see whales.
And we did see blue whales.
zh: 而我们确实看到了蓝鲸。
zh_hant: 而我們確實看到了藍鯨。

text: There were quite a lot of them,
and we saw a mother and her baby.
So even a baby blue whale is absolutely huge.
zh: 所以哪怕是幼鲸也大得惊人。
zh_hant: 所以哪怕是幼鯨也大得驚人。

text: And we were in a very small boat.
zh: 而我们在一条很小的船上。
zh_hant: 而我們在一條很小的船上。

text: It wasn't a tourist big boat.
It was just us.
And when you're on a small boat and you can see these huge whales,
zh: 当你坐在小船上，看到这些巨大的鲸鱼时，
zh_hant: 當你坐在小船上，看到這些巨大的鯨魚時，

text: it was quite amazing.
Yeah, I'm a bit jealous.
What wild animals have you seen?
I saw an animal called a vicuna.
zh: 我见过一种叫骆马的动物。
zh_hant: 我見過一種叫駱馬的動物。

text: I've never heard of that.
What animal is that?
It's like a llama or an alpaca, but it's smaller.
zh: 有点像美洲驼或者羊驼，但体型更小。
zh_hant: 有點像美洲駝或者羊駝，但體型更小。

text: And I was in South America,
out in the middle of nowhere, in the countryside,
zh: 在野外、偏僻的乡下地方，
zh_hant: 在野外、偏僻的鄉下地方，

text: and I went to a cafe and there was a vicuña in the cafe.
zh: 我去了一家咖啡馆，里面有一只骆马。
zh_hant: 我去了一家咖啡館，裡面有一隻駱馬。

text: Inside the cafe?
Yeah.
And that was really surprising, but also really cute.
zh: 那真的很让人意外，但也真的很可爱。
zh_hant: 那真的很讓人意外，但也真的很可愛。

text: Was it a wild animal or a pet of the cafe?
zh: 那它是野生动物还是咖啡馆的宠物？
zh_hant: 那它是野生動物還是咖啡館的寵物？

text: I'm not really sure.
I don't know if vicuñas make pets.
zh: 我不知道骆马能不能当宠物养。
zh_hant: 我不知道駱馬能不能當寵物養。

text: Are there any animals that you would like to see in the wild?
zh: 有没有你想在野外看到的动物？
zh_hant: 有沒有你想在野外看到的動物？

text: Yeah,
I think I would like to see a lion in the wild.
zh: 我觉得我想在野外看到狮子。
zh_hant: 我覺得我想在野外看到獅子。

text: But also,
I wouldn't like to see a lion
zh: 我也不想在野外看到狮子，
zh_hant: 我也不想在野外看到獅子，

text: in the wild because that could be the end of your life.
zh: 因为那可能就是你的死期了。
zh_hant: 因為那可能就是你的死期了。

text: So it depends on the circumstances.
Fences.
Yes, I was thinking about tigers,
that I would like to see a tiger in the wild.
But again,
I don't want to just be walking up a mountain and suddenly,
zh: 我不想正走在山上，突然，
zh_hant: 我不想正走在山上，突然，

text: oh, a tiger is right in front of me.
zh: 哇，一只老虎就在我面前。
zh_hant: 哇，一隻老虎就在我面前。

text: I would not like that.
No.
So would you like to go on a safari, for example?
zh: 那你会想去参加野生动物园之旅吗，比如？
zh_hant: 那你會想去參加野生動物園之旅嗎，比如？

text: I would.
Yes, I would really like to go on safari because you can see so many animals in the wild there,
zh: 是的，我非常想去野生动物园，因为在野外能看到很多动物，
zh_hant: 是的，我非常想去野生動物園，因為在野外能看到很多動物，

text: all the lions and elephants.
Hippos.
Sounds amazing.
OK, it's time to recap the vocabulary that we used in this podcast.
zh: 好的，是时候回顾一下我们在本期播客中使用的词汇了。
zh_hant: 好的，是時候回顧一下我們在本期播客中使用的詞彙了。

text: We talked about wild animals.
If an animal is wild,
zh: 如果一种动物是野生的，
zh_hant: 如果一種動物是野生的，

text: it means it lives without the help of humans.
zh: 那就意味着它生活在没有人类帮助的环境中。
zh_hant: 那就意味著它生活在沒有人類幫助的環境中。

text: And we also use wild as a noun – the wild.
zh: 我们也把野生用作名词——野外。
zh_hant: 我們也把野生用作名詞——野外。

text: So this means places that are natural,
where humans don't help animals or plants.
zh: 人类不帮助动物或植物的地方。
zh_hant: 人類不幫助動物或植物的地方。

text: And we talked about some of the animals we want to see,
zh: 我们还聊了一些我们想看到的动物，
zh_hant: 我們還聊了一些我們想看到的動物，

text: using the structure would like to plus the infinitive.
zh: 用了“would like to”加动词原形的结构。
zh_hant: 用了“would like to”加動詞原形的結構。

text: So, for example, I would like to see lions.
And I would like to go on safari.
zh: 还有我想去野生动物园之旅。
zh_hant: 還有我想去野生動物園之旅。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这期的《真正简易英语》就到这里。
zh_hant: 這期的《真正簡易英語》就到這裡。

text: Don't forget to go to our website where you can find a
zh: 别忘了去我们的网站，那里可以找到一份
zh_hant: 別忘了去我們的網站，那裡可以找到一份

text: free worksheet to download.
That's at bbclearningenglish.com.
And we'll be back next week with another conversation in Easy English.
zh: 下个星期我们会回来，带来另一段简易英语对话。
zh_hant: 下個星期我們會回來，帶來另一段簡易英語對話。

text: Goodbye for now.
Goodbye.
